description: Puts the forge and vi-natural CLIs on PATH at session start. Before a call: refuses the shell commands whose damage cannot be undone, and stops once before a memory or skill write, including through the shell where the content cannot be read. After a call: hands every code file that changed — whichever route wrote it — to the linter the project itself configured, its own copy where it has one and the vendored one where it does not, and asks once when a checker is about to hard-code the cases it already knows. This plugin owns when and where a rule fires; the project owns what the rule says. It also records the documents a turn changed and asks once for a second model to read them. It also keeps the two second opinions in order: once the built-in advisor has spoken, no write lands until codex has read the tree, the advisor speaks before a codex consult, and what it said travels into that consult. Before a write to an issue, it refuses until that issue's comments have been read in this session, since the read that looks complete returns none of them.
